title: Changing a tool safely
summary: Change the Toolkit contract and its registry entry, then verify their generated projections.
audience: A contributor adding a tool operation or changing the input, result, receipt, error, or writer policy of an existing one.

sections.heading: Begin at the Toolkit and registry

claims.text: The Toolkit owns the eight wire contracts. The closed operation registry adds transition, writer, receipt, and correlation metadata for the same names. Change those two authorities together.
Input, result, receipt, and error types stay keyed by one operation name. A change should preserve that relationship instead of making callers repeat type arguments or handle a union of every result.

Regenerate contract projections after changing the Toolkit, and inspect the registry projection after changing execution metadata. Both public authorities should still expose the same operation names.
Regenerate the API manifest after changing either authority, then revalidate the guides that cite the changed signature or source facts.
